Workfront is a recruitment agency connecting skilled candidates with permanent employment opportunities across a range of industries.

Our client is a well-established manufacturer of Magnesium Oxide and Magnesium Carbonate and is seeking an Assistant Mechanical Engineer to join their team in Young, NSW. Reporting to the Plant Manager/Managing Director, you will work closely with plant operators and maintenance tradespeople to support the safe, reliable and efficient operation of a busy chemical manufacturing facility.

Salary: $80,000 - $90,000 per annum (depending on qualifications and experience), plus superannuation.

About the Role
This hands-on position is suited to an engineer with experience in heavy industrial or chemical manufacturing who enjoys working in a practical production environment. You will assist with maintaining plant reliability, supporting maintenance activities and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives.

Qualifications, Experience & Skills
To be successful in this role you will have:
•	Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering.
•	Minimum two (2) years' experience in a 24/7 chemical manufacturing environment involving rotary and vertical shaft kilns.
•	Strong ability to work effectively within a team.
•	Excellent organisational and time management skills with the ability to prioritise competing tasks.
•	Strong written and verbal communication skills.
•	Proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel.
•	Experience with CAD and ERP software (desirable).

Key Responsibilities
Your responsibilities will include:
•	Assist with the design and construction of equipment used for calcination of minerals, material conveying and handling, crushing, sieving, grinding and packaging.
•	Supervise the dismantling, refurbishment, assembly, installation and commissioning of plant and equipment.
•	Inspect plant and equipment to ensure optimum performance, including completion of operational, maintenance and housekeeping inspections.
•	Assist in planning and supervising preventative maintenance programs while implementing strategies to minimise equipment breakdowns.
•	Maintain inventory levels of critical spare parts.
•	Attend site outside normal working hours when equipment failures require urgent attention.
•	Maintain accurate maintenance records and compliance documentation.
•	Supervise maintenance personnel and contractors to ensure work is completed safely, efficiently and to the required standard.
•	Liaise with internal departments and external suppliers to support maintenance, procurement and continuous improvement projects.

We are a wholly Australian owned and operated ICT and Telecom networks specialist delivery business. Dipole operates locally, regionally, and internationally. Our capabilities span across Telecommunications, Finance, Insurance, health, Public Services, Print / Digital Media, Broadcast and Supply Chain. Dipole Group is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Position Overview
We are seeking an experienced Backup & Storage Administrator to join our Managed Services team supporting mission-critical telecommunications infrastructure and enterprise platforms. The successful candidate will be responsible for the administration, monitoring, maintenance, optimization, and lifecycle management of enterprise backup and storage environments, ensuring high availability, performance, data protection, business continuity, and disaster recovery in accordance with agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

Key Responsibilities: 

Storage Administration: 
Administer and support enterprise storage environments across Production, UAT, Development, Test, and Disaster Recovery environments.
Manage SAN, NAS, Fibre Channel, iSCSI, and enterprise storage infrastructure.
Perform storage provisioning, LUN allocation, zoning, masking, expansion, and capacity management.
Monitor storage health, performance, utilization, and availability using enterprise monitoring tools.
Perform storage performance tuning and optimization.
Support storage replication, snapshots, cloning, and disaster recovery solutions.
Perform firmware upgrades, storage migrations, lifecycle management, and maintenance activities.
Troubleshoot and resolve storage-related incidents within agreed SLA and KPI targets.
Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and implement preventive measures.

Backup Administration:
Administer and support enterprise backup infrastructure.
Configure and manage backup policies, schedules, retention policies, and media management.
Monitor backup jobs and ensure successful completion of backup and restore operations.
Perform backup recovery testing and validation.
Manage backup replication between Production and Disaster Recovery environments.
Perform backup infrastructure upgrades, patching, and maintenance.
Support disaster recovery exercises and business continuity testing.
Troubleshoot failed backup jobs and optimize backup performance.
Ensure backup compliance with security, governance, and retention requirements.

Operational Support:
Collaborate with Database, VMware, Linux, Windows, Network, Security, and Application Support teams.
Participate in Incident, Problem, Change, Release, and Capacity Management processes following ITIL best practices.
Develop operational documentation, runbooks, knowledge articles, and standard operating procedures.
Ensure compliance with operational procedures, security standards, and governance requirements.
Identify automation opportunities and implement continuous service improvements.
Participate in planned maintenance activities and 24x7 on-call support rotations.

Required Experience:
Minimum 4 years of experience in Enterprise Backup and Storage Administration.
Experience working within Managed Services or Enterprise Infrastructure Operations.
Experience supporting large-scale enterprise backup and storage environments.
Experience working in mission-critical production environments with strict SLA and KPI commitments.
Experience supporting Telecommunications, Service Providers, or large enterprise environments is highly desirable.
Experience working in 24x7 operational support environments.

Title: OutSystems Developer / Consultant
Company: KRE8 IT Pty Ltd
Location: Narre Warren / Melbourne based preferred, with the option to work remotely within Australia. Applicants must be based in Australia due to the regulatory requirements of some of our clients.
Salary: $110,000 - $140,000 per annum, depending on relevant experience
Employment type: Full-time

About KRE8 IT
KRE8 IT is a Melbourne-based technology consulting company specialising in practical software delivery, low-code development, systems integration, and digital transformation. We work with clients to design, build, and support business-critical applications, with a strong focus on governed delivery, maintainable architecture, and high-quality outcomes.
We are seeking an OutSystems Developer / Consultant to support the design, development, implementation, and ongoing improvement of OutSystems applications for our clients.

About the role
The OutSystems Developer / Consultant will work across the full delivery lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, application development, integration, testing, deployment support, and continuous improvement. The role requires strong hands-on OutSystems development capability as well as the ability to work in a consulting environment with clients and internal delivery teams.

Key responsibilities
*   Design, develop, test, and maintain applications using OutSystems.
*   Work with both OutSystems O11 and OutSystems Developer Cloud environments.
*   Translate business requirements into reliable, maintainable application solutions.
*   Develop integrations with external systems, APIs, data services, and business platforms.
*   Support implementation of complex business workflows, decision logic, and rules-driven functionality.
*   Collaborate with clients, stakeholders, designers, analysts, and other developers to deliver fit-for-purpose solutions.
*   Contribute to application architecture, technical design, estimation, documentation, and delivery planning.
*   Troubleshoot, optimise, and improve existing OutSystems applications.
*   Support quality assurance, deployment activities, and production support where required.
*   Apply secure, scalable, and maintainable development practices.

Required experience, qualifications, and skills
*   Minimum 1 year of experience developing applications with OutSystems, including both O11 and ODC.
*   A Bachelor’s degree or higher in a relevant field is required. Where the qualification is not directly relevant to the position, the applicant must demonstrate a minimum of 3 years of relevant work experience.
